transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (1259x1140) screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form; no app branding visible -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 21/03/2013 (D/M/Y) agrees with the file name. Height axis uniform: 2.7 px/cm (250 cm at y300, 0 at y975). Boundaries 230/218/200/187/175/144/100/0 from bar edges (top border rows fall on integer cm) and H-column lines; table rows mapped one-to-one. A vertical blue line in the H column spans ~200-144 cm (cumulative-shear-stress style marker, not interpreted). Hardness axis non-linear (K, P, 1F, 4F, F at 216/108/54/27/~13 px from the bar origin). Bars: F, 4F+ (6 px past 4F), K (on the K gridline), P, P+ (40 px past P), K- (5 px short of the K- position), P+; R-column icons agree. Temperatures on 13.5 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F/0 gridline). No marker at the surface: the dashed air segment (from -2.6 at the plot top) runs straight to the first circle at 220 cm (HS-10); printed surface temp -2.4 kept in header notes only. Markers every 10 cm 220-160, then 140 and 100 cm; the line ends at 100 cm (no temperatures below). Markers 190-100 cm lie inside the hatched bars (ring detection/visual, +-0.2 C); 190 and 180 cm sit on the 0 C gridline.
